title.en: An Act Creating the Barrios of Luz, Linantuyan and Hilaitan in the Municipality of Guihulungan, Province of Negros Oriental
title.orig: An Act Creating the Barrios of Luz, Linantuyan and Hilaitan in the Municipality of Guihulungan, Province of Negros Oriental

text.en:
The following barrios are hereby created in the Municipality of Guihulungan, Province of Negros Oriental:
1. Barrio Luz, consisting of the sitios of Magbala-as, (large), Cambalo, Dadiangao, Agbabakid, Banogbanog, Hinoba-an (small), Taluktok, Hinogpayan, Balingos, Kanapu-an, Mahilig, Takung and Bonbong;
2. Barrio Linantuyan, consisting of the sitios of Magbala-as (small), Aya (small), Magkilignit, Taloto, Hinoba-an (large), Gusa (small), Alamag and Salong; and
3. Barrio Hilaitan, consisting of the sitios of Marilao, Ilaya, Kambulongnon, Busay, Danao, Manhantik, Tinagducan, Katawan, Mambug, Panlubiran and Himaya.

This Act shall take effect upon its approval.
Approved: June 21, 1959.
